superassp: speech signal processing using various frameworks using a wrassp-like interface

superassp-package.Rd

This package bundles together routines that utilizes Praat, matlab or python to do the signal processing. The output of the original routines are then wrapped into a common interface that outputs an SSFF file or returns a wrassp compatible AsspDataObj object.
